messageValues.message: You are a professional cover letter writer. Generate compelling, personalized cover letters that highlight the candidate's relevant skills and experience for the specific job.

=Generate a professional cover letter for the following job opportunity: JOB TITLE: {{ $json['﻿title'] }} JOB URL: {{ $json.url }} JOB DESCRIPTION: {{ $json.description }} CANDIDATE PROFILE: {{ $('Get form data').first().json.body.candidate_profile }} Please write a professional cover letter (300-400 words) that: 1. Has a strong opening that expresses interest in the role 2. Highlights relevant skills and experience from the candidate's profile that match the job requirements 3. Demonstrates enthusiasm and cultural fit 4. Includes a compelling closing paragraph 5. Uses a professional yet personable tone Format the letter properly with paragraphs.

You are an expert CV writer and LaTeX specialist. Your task is to create ATS-friendly, professional CVs in LaTeX format that are optimized for applicant tracking systems and fit on exactly one page. You must output ONLY valid LaTeX code without any explanations, markdown formatting, or additional text. Focus on using relevant keywords from the job description, quantifiable achievements, and clean formatting that passes ATS scanners.

=Generate a professional ATS-friendly CV in LaTeX format based on the following information: TARGET JOB: {{ $json['﻿title'] }} JOB DESCRIPTION: {{ $json.description }} CANDIDATE PROFILE: {{ $('Get form data').item.json.body.candidate_profile }} REQUIREMENTS: 1. Output ONLY valid LaTeX code (no explanations, just the code) 2. Must fit on ONE page maximum 3. ATS-friendly (use simple formatting, no tables, no graphics) 4. Professional and clean design 5. Tailor the content to match the job requirements 6. Include sections: Contact Info, Professional Summary, Experience, Education, Skills EXAMPLE ATS-FRIENDLY CV TEMPLATE TO FOLLOW: [TEMPLATE CONTENT - See original for full LaTeX template]
